status: natural re-blocking (product-owner decision 2026-10-05); relayout 2026-10-06 (owner satellite view). L_YARD family, derived from the S17 base painting with art/tools/derive_era.py (same camera: walk_band, actor_scale and anchors identical to S17).
note: Same camera as S17 (relayout 2026-10-06 after the owner's satellite view): yard side of ZS Sokolikova 2, camera ~2.1 m on the yard asphalt at the SE corner of the court looking SW at the three-storey yard facade (corner x 431, yard door x 997-1055); horizon y 380, prop foot line y 700, s(y) = (y - 380) / 635; the red clay running track with grass inside on the LEFT, the court fence running away from the camera on the RIGHT (6.6 m right of the camera) with the court behind it, the paved way along the fence to the yard door, the round steel dustbin by the fence at the yard edge. Late October 2020, base state before E10: the art panel, the linden, its grass bed, the bench and the low service wall are gone - the corner is plain patched asphalt (only the short stub of the red pipe remains at its axis x 1382); temporary distance markings of the pickup point (a row of short yellow dashes at y ~765) are painted on the asphalt below the spot where the linden stood; behind the fence the court is now a football pitch with artificial turf (owner 2026-10-06; no basketball baskets any more); the dustbin by the fence is a green plastic wheelie bin ('Kos'). After E10 the variant S55_linden_and_wall puts back the big linden (trunk foot 620,690), its green bed, the bench and the preserved wall with the 3x4 stone panel (the cache in row 2 / column 3); D05 opens the cache (state patch S55_cache_open).
